name: AI Alt Text Generator for Images - AutoAlt.ai
description: Generates AI alt text for image files via the AutoAlt.ai API, with single-image and bulk workflows.
project_description:
AI Alt Text Generator for Images in Drupal automatically generates accurate, descriptive alt text and image names generation using advanced AI image analysis . Designed for SEO optimization and accessibility compliance, this module helps you fix alt text across your entire Drupal website in just a few clicks.

 
 AutoAlt.ai works directly inside the Drupal Media Library , allowing you to generate alt text for single images or in bulk . Whether you manage a blog, business website, or a large Drupal Commerce store, the module ensures every image is properly described, accessible, and search-engine friendly.

 

 Features 
 
 
 AI Alt Text Generator 
 
 
 Auto Image name generation 
 
 
 Bulk Alt Text Generation for the entire media library 
 
 
 Process Individual Image 
 
 
 Image Processing History with search filters 
 
 
 Quick Edit Alt Text Language wise from History page 
 
 
 Multilingual Capabilities 
 
 
 Included / Excluded Keywords 
 
 
 Prefix and Suffix settings for branding 
 
 
 Support for SVG & AVIF 
 
 
 Process Images with Specific File Extensions only 
 
 
 Writing Style Selection 
 
 
 Generate Alt Text with Min/Max Character Limits 
 
 
 Customize with ChatGPT 
 
 
 Try for FREE 
 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Once installed, follow these steps to start using the module:

 
 
 Go to Configuration → AutoAlt Settings: 

 Enter your AutoAlt.ai API key and other optional settings.
 
 
 Visit Any Content Type with an Image Field: 

 The module automatically enhances image widgets.
 
 
 Use the AutoAlt Button: 

 On any image field, you’ll see a “Generate Alt Text” button.
 
 Click it to automatically fetch AI-generated alt text. 
 The button shows a loading indicator and becomes disabled until the text is ready. 
 
 
 
 Review / Save: 

 Edit the generated text if needed and save your content as usual.
 
 
 No new content types or text formats are required. The module works instantly with standard Drupal image fields.

 Additional Requirements 
 This module requires:

 
 AutoAlt.ai API Key: Free and paid plans are available. 
 
 Supporting this Module

 AutoAlt.ai provides the AI engine used to generate high-quality alt text.
